title: The derived adjunction unit on a single object induces the ordinary unit in degree zero
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian] with derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and suppose $\mathcal D$ has enough injectives [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Let $L:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ and $R:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ be additive functors with an adjunction $L\dashv R$, with $L$ exact and $R$ left exact [def-sp-left-exact-additive, lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization]. Write $L_D$ for the termwise bounded-below derived functor, $R^+R$ for the bounded-below right derived functor [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], and $\eta^D:\mathrm{id}\to(R^+R)L_D$ for the actual induced derived-adjunction unit [lem-trf-bounded-below-derived-adjunction]. For every $M\in\mathcal C$ there is an isomorphism $c:\mathcal H^0((R^+R)L_D(M[0]))\simeq R(LM)$ such that $c\circ\mathcal H^0(\eta^D_{M[0]})=\eta_M\circ\epsilon_M$, where $\epsilon_M:\mathcal H^0(M[0])\simeq M$ is the single-complex homology isomorphism and $\eta$ is the original adjunction unit.

proof.text: Use the defining derived-unit factorization on a bounded-below homotopy single complex. The exact-functor single comparison factors through the homotopy localization comparison. Naturality of the right-derived unit along the mapped-single isomorphism reduces the formula to the ordinary adjunction unit on complexes. Check this in degree zero by naturality of the ordinary unit along singleObjXSelf, and in all other degrees by the zero source.

proof.text: Apply degree-zero homology. The existing proved rightDerivedPlusSingleUnitHomology_comp_comparison identifies the single right-derived unit with toRightDerivedZero. This last map is invertible because R is left exact. Compose its inverse with the exact-single and right-derived single homology comparisons. Naturality of the single-complex homology comparison gives the displayed equation.

theorem derivedPlus_unit_homology_zero [PreservesFiniteLimits R] (M : C) :
    ∃ e : (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor C 0).obj
          ((L.mapDerivedCategoryPlus ⋙ R.rightDerivedFunctorPlus).obj
            ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor C 0).obj M)) ≅ R.obj (L.obj M),
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor C 0).map
          (adj.derivedPlus.unit.app ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor C 0).obj M)) ≫
        e.hom =
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctorCompHomologyFunctorIso 0).hom.app M ≫
        adj.unit.app M
